title: 第39章 对咱们态度不一样了

第39章 对咱们态度不一样了-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

“王超那个人，我在镇上听人说过，名声确实不太好。”

陈建国的声音压低了，“但这话我不敢跟美丽说，说了她也不信。

她现在满脑子都是嫁到镇上去，觉得那是好日子。”

林国强沉默了一会儿，说：“该说的我都说了，她不信，我有什么办法？”

“二哥，你说美丽以后会不会……”

“会。”林国强打断了他，“但她不撞南墙不会回头。

有些人就是这样，你说一万句，不如她自己摔一跤。”

陈建民叹了口气，不说话了。

林美玲在旁边听着，眼圈红了：“二哥，你说美丽要是真出了事，咋办？”

林国强放下筷子，看着他们，认真地说：“美丽现在听不进去我的话，我说什么都是错的。

等她吃了亏，就知道谁是真的对她好了。”

林美玲低下头，抹了抹眼泪。

“别哭了，大过年的。”林国强给她夹了一块肉，“吃饭。”

回去的路上，赵素梅问他：“你觉得美丽那门亲事，真会出问题？”

“会。”林国强说，“但不是现在，得过个一年半载的，王超的狐狸尾巴才会露出来。”

“那到时候……”

“到时候再说。”

林国强蹬着自行车，风从耳边呼呼地吹过，“现在说什么都没用，她不会听的。”

赵素梅不说话了，把脸贴在他背上。

初四，林国强又走了几家亲戚。

赵素梅的大姐二姐家，还有几个堂叔伯家。

跟往年不一样的是，今年不管走到哪家，大家对他的态度都客气了不少。

以前走亲戚，别人看他都是那种“这家人穷，少跟他来往”的眼神，说话的时候爱搭不理的，坐一会儿就冷场。

今年不一样了，一进门就有人招呼，“国强来了”“快坐快坐”“喝杯茶”，热情得他都有点不适应。

赵素梅的大姐赵素芳。

以前最看不上林国强的一个。

今年也变了。

她拉着赵素梅的手，小声说：“素梅，你家国强现在可不一样了。

听说在镇上开了店，生意好得很？你可是熬出来了。”

赵素梅笑了笑，没说什么，但心里美得很。

回来的路上，赵素梅坐在自行车后座上，忽然说了一句：“国强，你发现没有，今年大家对咱们的态度都不一样了。”

“发现了。”

"I heard that Wang Chao has a bad reputation in town."

Chen Jianguo's voice lowered, "But I don't dare to say this to Meili, and she won't believe it even if I say it.

Now all she could think about was marrying in the town, thinking that would be a good life."

Lin Guoqiang was silent for a while and said, "I have said everything I need to say, but she doesn't believe it. What can I do?"

"Second brother, do you think you will be beautiful in the future..."

"Yes." Lin Guoqiang interrupted him, "But she won't look back until she hits the wall.

Some people are like this. If you say 10,000 words, it would be better for her to fall down on her own."

Chen Jianmin sighed and stopped talking.

Lin Meiling was listening next to her with red eyes: "Second brother, what do you think we will do if something happens to Meili?"

Lin Guoqiang put down his chopsticks, looked at them, and said seriously: "Meili can't listen to my words now, everything I say is wrong.

When she suffers a loss, she will know who is really good to her."

Lin Meiling lowered her head and wiped her tears.

"Stop crying, it's Chinese New Year." Lin Guoqiang gave her a piece of meat and said, "Eat."

On the way back, Zhao Sumei asked him: "Do you think there will really be problems with Meili's marriage?"

"Yes." Lin Guoqiang said, "But not now. It will take a year and a half before Wang Chao's fox tail will show up."

"Then when the time comes..."

"We'll talk about it then."

Lin Guoqiang pedaled his bicycle, the wind whistling by his ears, "It's useless to say anything now, she won't listen."

Zhao Sumei stopped talking and put her face on his back.

On the fourth day of the Lunar New Year, Lin Guoqiang visited several relatives.

Zhao Sumei's eldest sister, second sister's family, and several cousins' families.

What was different from previous years was that no matter where he went this year, everyone was much more polite to him.

When visiting relatives in the past, others would look at him like "this family is poor, don't interact with them anymore". He would be rude when talking, and would become silent after just sitting for a while.

This year was different. As soon as he walked in, someone greeted him, "Guoqiang is here", "Sit down quickly" and "Have a cup of tea". He was so enthusiastic that he felt a little uncomfortable.

Zhao Sufang, Zhao Sumei’s eldest sister.

Lin Guoqiang was the one who used to look down upon the most.

This year has changed too.

She took Zhao Sumei's hand and whispered: "Su Mei, your family's Guoqiang is different now.

I heard that I opened a store in town and the business is doing very well?You made it through."

Zhao Sumei smiled and said nothing, but she felt very beautiful.

On the way back, Zhao Sumei sat on the back seat of the bicycle and suddenly said: "Guoqiang, have you noticed that everyone's attitude towards us is different this year?"

"Found it."
